idea: Substitute the given values into v = i * z, then solve for i by multiplying by the inverse of z. Verify the resulting complex arithmetic by ring normalization.
proof:
subst v z
rw [h₁] at h₀
have hz : (2 - Complex.I : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
  norm_num
rw [h₂] at h₀
field_simp [hz] at h₀ ⊢
linear_combination h₀
